positions.name: Premature Légal sacrifice
positions.caution: Bxd1 loses to mate, but Nxe5 can instead win a knight for Black; reject excessive objective risk.

positions.name: Blackburne Shilling bait
positions.caution: Famous bait is objectively dubious; selecting a normal developing move can be correct.

positions.name: Fishing Pole hook
positions.caution: One tempting capture is not a forced win; the model should weigh alternative human replies.

positions.name: Englund queen fork
positions.caution: Requires several later mistakes; the initial Bd2 reply is a correct defense, and a one-reply model should not count the full trap as certain.

positions.name: Immediate mate control
positions.caution: Certain checkmate must remain preferred over speculative traps.
